?context: Tutorial, step 1 of 6, full hull; the player presses Continue
en: This 22 m fast attack craft floats, but it is too narrow to sit steady and has no main gun or radar. Fit it out, then take it to sea.

?context: Tutorial, step 1 of 6, fallback hull with Float already at Pass
en: This 22 m fast attack craft floats steady, but it has no main gun or radar. Fit it out, then take it to sea.

?context: Tutorial, step 1 of 6, fallback hull with engine and fuel tank fitted
en: This 22 m fast attack craft already has an engine and fuel, but no main gun or radar. Fit it out, then take it to sea.

?context: Tutorial, step 1, fallback hull fitted except for its gun
en: This 22 m fast attack craft is ready for sea except for one thing: it has no main gun.

?context: Tutorial, step 2; the beam handle is a ring on the hull, framed on screen; Float and Pass are gauge names
en: Drag the framed beam handle up or to the right to widen the hull, until the Float gauge shows Pass. A wider hull rolls less.

?context: Tutorial, step 2 as a 20 s demonstration; Float and Pass are gauge names
en: Watch the beam handle. Widening the hull is how Float reached Pass.

?context: Tutorial, step 3, four kits; a dropped kit moves to its place on the hull by itself
en: Drag the gun, radar mast, engine and fuel tank from the tray onto the hull. Each one settles into its place.

?context: Tutorial, step 3, two kits; a dropped kit moves to its place on the hull by itself
en: Drag the gun and the radar mast from the tray onto the hull. Each one settles into its place.

?context: Tutorial, the one-drag fallback; the dropped gun moves to its place by itself
en: Drag the gun from the tray onto the hull. It settles into its place.

?context: Tutorial, step 4; Ship's Notes is a panel name; the framed fix button reads Move and the gun's name; Accept fix is a button
en: The gun sits low in the bow, so the hull blocks most of its arc. In Ship's Notes, press the framed Move button, then Accept fix.

?context: Tutorial, step 4 as a demonstration; Fix is a button
en: The gun sits low in the bow, so the hull blocks most of its arc. Watch the preview of the Fix, then it is applied for you.

?context: Tutorial, step 5; Space is the splash key
en: Press Space to splash. Your ship goes into a test basin with drones to shoot at.

?context: Tutorial, step 5 in the splash basin; W, A, S and D are helm keys; the guns fire without the player
en: Press W a few times to get under way: each press rings up more speed. Steer with A and D. The guns find and hit the drones on their own.

?context: Tutorial, step 6; Space is the splash key, in the dry dock or in the basin
en: Splash again with Space. This time a patrol boat fires back.

?context: Tutorial, step 6 in the splash basin; W, A and D are helm keys; Rewind 30 s is a button
en: Beat the patrol boat. Press W to close inside your gun's reach, and steer with A and D to throw off its aim. Press Rewind 30 s if you are hit hard.

?context: Tutorial, step 6; Officers is a dry dock tab, Aggression a slider name, framed on screen
en: In the dry dock's Officers tab, move the framed Aggression slider. It sets how eagerly the gunnery officer engages.

?context: Tutorial, step 6; Space is the splash key
en: Splash once more with Space to see the new setting at work.

?context: Tutorial, last step; the reward hull is added to the player's blueprints
en: Done. The fully fitted fast attack craft is now in your blueprints.

?context: Tutorial, last step of the one-drag fallback
en: Done. The fully fitted fast attack craft is now in your blueprints. Try it against the patrol boat next.

?context: Tutorial card, after step 2: what the player achieved; the hull then settles on its design beam
en: Float shows Pass. The hull settles at its working beam and sits steady.

?context: Tutorial card, after step 3: what the player achieved
en: All four kits are fitted.

?context: Tutorial card, after step 3 of a fallback: what the player achieved
en: The gun and the radar mast are fitted.

?context: Tutorial card, after the one-drag fallback's kit step
en: The gun is fitted.

?context: Tutorial card, after step 4: what the player achieved
en: The gun's arc is clear.

?context: Tutorial card, after the drones: what the player achieved
en: Your guns opened fire on the drones.

?context: Tutorial card, after the patrol boat: what the player achieved
en: The patrol boat is out of the fight.

?context: Tutorial card, after the Aggression slider: what the player achieved
en: Aggression is set.
